title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winner of Grand Lotto P284M jackpot in Oct.19 draw
summary: Winners remained elusive for the major jackpot draws on October 19, where the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize is now over P284 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Monday.

blocks.text: Winners remained elusive for the major jackpot draws on October 19, where the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize is now over P284 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Monday.
No bettor selected the winning combination of 14-52-49-39-35-05 for the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot that has reached P284,685,354.80.
According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot are exactly 1 in 28,989,675.
It was the same result for Megalotto 6/45 after no bettor took home the P15,000,000.00 prize whose correct numbers of 16-03-24-34-41-31 were left unplayed.
On Friday, Oct.16, a Megalotto 6/45 bettor from Camarines Sur became P115 million richer after getting the winning combination.
